name: ai-job-applier
description: Monorepo para automatizacion de postulaciones laborales con IA.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm --prefix apps/worker run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/dashboard && npm --prefix apps/worker run build
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/dashboard && npm --prefix apps/worker run lint
